name: determinant
description: A human-auditable deterministic boundary between probabilistic AI and executable software.

scripts.test:en: npm run build && node --test test/compiler.test.mjs test/http.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs benchmark/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.compile:example: npm run build && node bin/determinant.mjs examples/order/app.aal --binding examples/order/binding.json --out generated/order.ts
scripts.compile:example:zh: npm run build && node bin/determinant.mjs examples/order/app.zh-CN.aal --language zh-CN --binding examples/order/binding.zh-CN.json --out generated/order.zh-CN.ts
scripts.demo:http: npm run build && node bin/determinant.mjs run examples/items/app.aal --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000
scripts.demo:http:zh: npm run build && node bin/determinant.mjs run examples/items/app.zh-CN.aal --language zh-CN --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000
scripts.demo:order-refund: npm run build && node bin/determinant.mjs run examples/order-refund/app.zh-CN.aal --language zh-CN --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000 --fixture examples/order-refund/fixture.v1.json --clock 2026-01-08T00:00:00.000Z
scripts.benchmark:run: npm run benchmark:score && npm run benchmark:aggregate
